page.content:
Ten-year siege of Troy that ends in the horse and the sack.

How Trojan War connects

  • Location: Troy — The Trojan War is the siege of Troy.
  • Work: Iliad — The Iliad recounts Achilles' portion of the Trojan War.
  • Character: Achilles — Achilles' wrath is the central action of the war in the Iliad.
  • Character: Odysseus — Odysseus fights at Troy and devises the wooden horse.
  • Character: Aphrodite — Aphrodite's gift of Helen to Paris sets the Trojan War in motion.
  • Character: Ares — Ares fights on the Trojan field in the Iliad.

What is Trojan War?

The Trojan War is the central heroic event of Greek epic: Helen, the oath of the suitors, Achilles' wrath, Hector's death, and Odysseus' device that opens the city.

Key threads lead to Troy, Iliad, Achilles, Odysseus, Aphrodite and Ares.
